items.title: 14.6 S.H.M. ki graph ke zariye numaindagi (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the graphs of S.H.M. (PDF 31).

blocks.text: S.H.M. karne wale jism ka displacement, velocity aur acceleration waqt ke muqable graphs par dikhaye ja sakte hain (Fig 14.9).

items: Displacement: x = xo cos(wt) (14.19). Inteha ki jagahon par zarre ka zyada se zyada displacement xo hai.

blocks.alt: Aik period mein displacement aur waqt ka graph, har chauthai period aur xo, -xo par dashed lakeerein. Curve +xo se shuru, sifar se guzar kar -xo tak aur wapas +xo tak.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.9 (a): S.H.M karte jism ke displacement ki graph ki shakal (kitab ki Figure 14.9 (a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Velocity: is ki miqdar xo w sin(wt) (14.20) hai; simt shamil karein to v = -xo w sin(wt). Raftar darmiyani jagah par zyada se zyada, xo w, aur intehaon par sifar hai.

blocks.alt: Aik period mein velocity ka graph, xo omega aur -xo omega ke darmiyan. Curve sifar se shuru, chauthai period par -xo omega, aadhe par sifar, teen chauthai par +xo omega aur phir sifar.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.9 (b): S.H.M karte jism ki velocity ki graph ki shakal (kitab ki Figure 14.9 (b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ka velocity graph sifar se pehle oopar jata hai, yani v = +xo w sin(wt). Lekin jab jism +xo se chhora jaye to woh O ki taraf, yani manfi simt mein chalta hai, is liye durust velocity v = -xo w sin(wt) hai aur graph sifar se pehle neeche jata hai; khaaka yahi dikhata hai. Teenon graph milayein: jahan displacement zyada se zyada hai wahan velocity sifar hai, aur acceleration hamesha displacement ke ulat hai.

items: Acceleration: a = -w^2 x; x = xo cos(wt) rakhne par a = -xo w^2 cos(wt) (14.21). Acceleration intehaon par zyada se zyada, xo w^2, aur darmiyani jagah par sifar hai.

blocks.alt: Aik period mein acceleration ka graph, omega square xo aur minus omega square xo ke darmiyan. Curve sab se manfi qeemat se shuru, aadhe period par zyada se zyada, phir wapas: hamesha displacement ke ulat.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.9 (c): S.H.M karte jism ke acceleration ki graph ki shakal (kitab ki Figure 14.9 (c) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Graphs se: velocity aur displacement ka phase farq pi/2 (chauthai chakkar) hai, aur acceleration aur displacement ka phase farq pi (aadha chakkar) hai, is liye acceleration hamesha displacement ke ulat hota hai.

blocks.title: Acceleration aur displacement mein pi ka farq
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke acceleration aur displacement ka phase farq pi/2 hai, aur displacement, velocity aur acceleration ka phase farq pi/2 hai. Kyunke a = -w^2 x, acceleration aur displacement bilkul ulat hain: un ka phase farq pi hai. Velocity in dono se pi/2 mukhtalif hai. Kitab ka velocity graph bhi ulti simt mein hai (sifar se oopar jata hai), jo x = xo cos(wt) se nahi milta; dobara banaye graphs equations ke mutabiq hain.

blocks.prompt: S.H.M. ke kin nuqton par (a) raftar aur (b) acceleration sab se zyada hain?
blocks.explanation: (a) Raftar darmiyani jagah par sab se zyada, xo w, hai. (b) Acceleration intehaon par sab se zyada, xo w^2, hai.

items: x = xo cos(wt); v = -xo w sin(wt); a = -xo w^2 cos(wt).
v aur x mein chauthai chakkar (pi/2); a, x ke ulat (pi).
